profile.headline: Core Developer Experience @LinkedIn
profile.summary: Solving problems and making positive impacts for humanity are what I am looking for. I am a fast learner and eager to learn new technology with all my enthusiasm and cability.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer @ Core Developer Experience
positions.description: Our team mission is building and operating the tools and infrastructure that LinkedIn engineers use to write, understand, build, and ship code.

positions.title: Community Lead Woman in Tech
positions.description: Organized community initiatives and events supporting mentorship, inclusion, and career development for engineers across the Bellevue site

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer @ Validation Platform
positions.description:
I'm still part of the Validation team, but now working on more exciting initiatives—like onboarding new partners to our validation platform, including data platforms, A/B testing for feature ramping, streaming jobs, and ML platforms to help them deploy new version more safely.

I’ve given technical talks at LinkedIn Women in Tech conferences about my work on the validation platform, including a new partnership that expanded safety coverage across thousands of deployments per day.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I work at Release Validation team, making sure every new deployment at LinkedIn is safe before rolling out to production

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Proton Team - A distributed streaming platform for Nordstrom, based on Apache Kafka
- Create an internal tool with appropriate authentication to on-board new team to streaming platform and record their data in S3 bucket.
- Work with a wide variety of front and back-end technologies. Experience with: Python, Kotlin, Java, HTML/CSS, React, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Docker/Kubernetes, AWS, Git CI/CD.
- Utilize leading software development with modern software engineering practices of unit testing, continuous intergration and deployment.
Machine Learning Platform Team - A platform helping data scientists accomplish more, faster
- Build a model predicting Harmonized Tariff Schedule by using AutoML libraries such as Autogluon, AutoKeras, NNI, and Model Search with an accuracy approximately 89%
- Research, design, and develop distributed machine learning pipelines that perform low latency responses in high load production environments by using Amazon EKS to scale up the Kubernetes application in the AWS cloud.

positions.title: Data Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Converted non-searchable pdf documents to searchable pdf, text, HOCR documents by using Python3, OpenCV, and Tesseract API with an accuracy up to 98% percent. 
•	Created batch processing program to convert 100 000 documents per day on distributed system by using multiple processing with Async.
•	Experienced with software processes in SCRUM environment: requirements, demos, source code control (Git/Bit Bucket), defect tracking (JIRA), estimation and planning, build, test automation.

positions.title: Grader
positions.description:
- Grader for CS120: Data Structures and Algorithms.
- Grader for CS110: Imperative Programming
- Grader for CS100: Introduction to Programming
- Hold office hours to help students.

positions.title: Student Technology Assistant at Educational Technology
positions.description:
•	Uploaded information to Wooster's Website by using HTML, CSS
•	Designed templates, posters and created videos for Ed-Tech by using Adobe Applications such as Illustrators, Premiere Pro and Final Cut Pro. 
•	Helped students, staffs and faculties to solve problems of OSX System and Window System.
•	Held workshops about Final Cut Pro and Adobe Illustrator to teach basic skills as well as tips and tricks for students, professors and staffs at Wooster.

positions.title: Tutor at Math Center
positions.description: - Tutor for multiple math classes: 107+108: PreCalculus; 111-112-212: Calculus 1&2&3; Linear Algebra

positions.title: STEM Zone Intern
positions.description:
•	 Taking class with students, answering questions and holding office hours. 
•	 Encouraging student to determine the focus of the session and to engage in planning what will be covered
•	 Using active learning techniques to ensure that the session allows time for the students to practice, to make their own discoveries.
•	 Helping student understand the concepts or procedures by providing opportunities to practice  and to get feed back.
•	Modeling a good student habits and promoting independence.

positions.title: AI Developer
positions.description:
•	Prepared and cleaned images dataset by taking 10 000 photos for 100 image classes, and processing through Computer Vision and OpenCV, blurring unnecessary details. 
•	Built a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model to recognize the contents of web-designed cards displayed in a digital image with an accuracy of 96%.
•	Generated a web-design sitemap from a digital image 
•	Used Python, Jupyter Notebook, Google Colab, and Amazon Web Services (AWS) ec2 instance.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
•	 Organized an exhibition to enhance the beauty of Hanoi and raised funds for handicapped children : $3000
•	Taught handicapped children to make bracelets and easy paints and sold in exhibition to raise funds
•	Collected and recorded cultural narrative of Vietnam using videos, sounds and writings.
•	Organized and invited media professionals including reporters, journalists and broadcasters.
•	Created Wordpress website by using HTML, CSS: 
Link to my fanpage: https://www.facebook.com/shadesofhanoi/?ref=br_rs

positions.title: Marketing Manager
positions.description:
• Worked in small team as well as individually to respond to almost 500 customer inquiries/per day and use Excel to fill in customer information.
• Developed and wrote influentially weekly bilingual content posts for Instagram, Facebook, and Snapchat.
• Dramatically increase engagement on Facebook for brands through innovative use of content. Facebook fanpage engagement have seen an increase from single digits to hundreds, even thousands on a daily basis. 
• Designed concepts for seasonal campaigns, took photos, and videos for advertisement by Adobe Suit.

educations.schoolName: Hanoi-Amsterdam High School for the Gifted

honors.title: Grace Hopper Scholarship - Bank of America
honors.description: A merit-based scholarship rewarded to top campus talent and high achieving candidates. The scholarship rewards recipients the opportunity to excel in classrooms and within the financial industry. The $5,000.00 stipend directly covers tuition and academic expenses for Fall 2018 semester.

honors.title: PyTorch Scholarship Challenge from Facebook
honors.description:
PyTorch is an open source deep learning framework that’s quickly become popular with AI researchers for its ease of use, clean Pythonic API, and flexibility. With the preview release of PyTorch 1.0, developers can now seamlessly move from exploration to production deployment using a single, unified framework.

This new scholarship program, announced today at the PyTorch Developer Conference, offers participants the opportunity to acquire cutting-edge skills in deep learning using PyTorch, and earn a full scholarship to Udacity’s Deep Learning Nanodegree program.
